endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: spokane_river_water_trail_mission_ave_access_anchor_20260918 spokane-river-water-trail-record-4001: The Spokane River Water Trail launches page lists Mission Ave. for canoe/kayak/SUP and labels it Whitewater Park & Play only. Its public map detail record ID 4001 names Mission Ave., publishes 47.671585,-117.180981, gives river mile 88.5, year-round season and daylight hours, and marks Whitewater Area and Canoe and Kayak. The published coordinate exactly matches the stored route point. Avista's recreation inventory separately identifies Sullivan Hole at the end of Mission Avenue as Spokane County trail access. These sources establish a paddler access site, not the surveyed water-entry toe; they do not support rafting or powerboat use here.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (spokane_river_water_trail_mission_ave_access_anchor_20260918 spokane-river-water-trail-record-4001) on Spokane River; this confirms the public access site, not the exact water-edge point. Confirm the water-edge location and carry before paddling.
